label: copy-phase echo of v (sparse subset)
explanation: Fires almost only in the copy phase (98.5% of mass), when the token fed back in is v (87% of mass; c is a weaker secondary trigger, ~10%). It is strongest early in the copy, at recall_idx 1-2, i.e. when v was the first or second original token; the top examples are sequences that start with v followed by v or w. Rates are also higher when the token being output is v, w, d or s. But it fires on only ~2% of copy-phase v inputs, so precision is very low: adding recall_idx and output-token conditions lifts precision to ~18-27% at the cost of half the recall, and F1 never gets above 0.26. Magnitude is higher at recall_idx 1 and for outputs v/w. It does not fire in the original phase, on the delimiter, or at recall_idx 0, and it almost never fires on other input tokens.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=v (+5.57), phase=2 & out_tok=v (+4.62), phase=2 & out_tok=w (+3.66), phase=2 & out_tok=d (+3.38), recall_idx=1 & in_tok=c (+3.10), orig0=w (+3.04). Lower it: orig_idx=-1 (-3.32), next_out=y (-2.98), prev2_tok=v (-2.59), prev_tok=d (-2.46).
